Ты услышишь диалог. Для каждого предложения А–Е выбери один правильный вариант ответа из трёх предложенных (1, 2 или 3). Ты услышишь текст дважды.

A. What do you know about Dan?
1) He is a pupil.
2) He is a new teacher.
3) He is the pupil's friend.

B. What subject is the boy going to have a test in?
1) English.
2) Music.
3) Maths.

C. What is the boy's favourite subject?
1) English.
2) Music.
3) Maths.

D. What does the boy hope to do at the English lesson? He hopes to ...
1) learn new words.
2) sing a new song.
3) meet a new teacher.

E. What does the boy want to do after the lessons? He wants to ...
1) listen to music.
2) do his homework.
3) eat pizza in the café.

Запиши в таблицу выбранные цифры под соответствующими буквами.

Прочитай текст. Для каждого предложения A–E выбери один правильный вариант ответа из трёх предложенных (1, 2 или 3).

Peter

Peter did not have any brothers or sisters. He was an only child. Peter lived in a big city near a river but he liked to go to the park in the afternoon after school when the weather was nice. He walked in the park and looked at other boys who played football there.

When it rained, his mum took him to the library where Peter chose a book to read. He liked reading very much. He enjoyed books about pirates and space explorers but he did not like fairy tales.

When Peter was ten years old his father said that he did not have a job any more. Peter's parents decided to sell their house in the city and move to a small village. Peter was both happy and sad. He enjoyed living in a big city but he was happy because he hoped to have a lot of adventures in the countryside.

A. How many children were there in Peter's family?
1) one
2) two
3) three

B. What did Peter do in the park?
1) He played football.
2) He read books.
3) He walked.

C. What books did Peter like reading? He liked ...
1) books about football players.
2) books about adventures.
3) fairy tales.

D. What happened when Peter was ten years old?
1) His dad found a new job.
2) His father lost his job.
3) His father bought a new house in a big city.

E. Choose the true sentence.
1) Peter did not like his big city.
2) Peter hoped to have new adventures.
3) Peter didn't want to move to the village.

Запиши в таблицу выбранные цифры под соответствующими буквами.

Прочитай рассказ. Вставь вместо каждого пропуска, обозначенного буквами A–E, нужную грамматическую форму, выбрав её из трёх предложенных вариантов (1, 2 или 3).

Lake Baikal

Last year I visited Siberia. I A _____ Lake Baikal. It is a very beautiful deep lake. It is also the B _____ freshwater lake in the world. It is 25 million years old. There are about 100 volcanoes but there are C _____ active ones. 336 rivers flow into Lake Baikal. Only one flows out, which is the Upper Angara. There are more than thirty rocky islands in this lake. One of them is Olkhon. A lot of people D _____ it every year. Lake Baikal is home to thousands of different plants and animals. People like taking photos of E _____.

A 1) see 2) saw 3) seeing
B 1) oldest 2) older 3) old
C 1) some 2) any 3) no
D 1) visit 2) to visit 3) visiting
E 1) they 2) them 3) their

Помоги своему другу заполнить анкету для сайта «Друзья онлайн». Прочитай текст и запиши информацию в таблицу. Под каждым номером запиши только одно слово (без артиклей). Числа необходимо записать словами.

Tim Ivanov

Tim is from Russia. He is 9 years old. Tim lives in Saratov, in Russia. He has got a younger sister and an older brother. The children have got a cat. Tim likes playing football. He wants to be a professional football player in the future. He is a good pupil. His favourite subject is Maths. He likes juice but he doesn't like milk.

Name 1.
Age 2.
Country 3.
Number of children in the family 4.
Pet 5.
Favourite subject 6.
Favourite drink 7.
Favourite sport 8.

Ты услышишь диалог. Для каждого предложения A–E выбери один правильный вариант ответа из трёх предложенных (1, 2 или 3). Ты услышишь текст дважды.

Мы готовы начать.

Mum: Dan, are you going to have any tests at school tomorrow?
Dan: Yes, I am going to have a Maths test. I think I will get a good mark. I always do my homework.
Mum: What will you do at the English lesson?
Dan: I think we will learn some new words. It's great. I like English. By the way, we have a new Music teacher.
Mum: What's her name?
Dan: Her name is Anna Yurievna. I hope we will listen to some wonderful music at the lesson and learn a new song.
Mum: What are you going to do after the lessons tomorrow?
Dan: I want to go to the café to eat pizza with my classmate Tim. I will come home at 3 p.m.
Mum: When will you do your homework?
Dan: I'll do my homework after having lunch.
Mum: OK. I hope you'll have a great day.
